canonical_claim: For every first-order language and theory T, T has a nonempty model if and only if every finite set of sentences contained in T has a nonempty model.
domain_and_universes: A many-sorted-by-arity first-order language L : FirstOrder.Language.{u,v} and an L-theory T (a set of L-sentences); exact universe serialization is deferred to the statement gate.

alternate_encodings.target: every finite subset of T, represented as a finite Set rather than a Finset, is satisfiable

excluded_degenerate_cases: The empty theory and empty finite subtheory are included. Models are nonempty by IsSatisfiable. No finiteness, countability, consistency, or cardinality assumption is added to the language or theory.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; the candidate mathlib proof uses classical reasoning and an ultraproduct construction; exact axiom closure remains to be audited
tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are candidate components; exact import, declaration, and transitive dependency closure remain open
computation_profile: noncomputable model-existence theorem; no oracle, solver, experiment, or certificate is intended
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on canonical wording, source edition, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, profile, or validator change; independent review and review due date remain open.
status_boundary: Planned intake only. The Lean declaration is an elaborated discovery candidate, but no canonical expression fingerprint, mutation suite, source acceptance, obligation registry, proof credit, accepted task state, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
